title: 111014-G-NV827-Sailor medevac
description:
CORPUS CHRISTI, Texas - The Coast Guard medevaced an 82-year old man from a sailing vessel approximately 17 miles south of Matagorda Bay, Friday.

Watchstanders at Sector Corpus Christi received a report at approximately 9 a.m., that an 82-year old man aboard the Cache, a 50-foot sailing vessel, suffered a head injury and required immediate medical assistance.

Interview with Petty Officer 3rd Class Andrew Wood conducted by Lt. Steven Vanderlaske.  U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Corpus Christi.
Interview with Petty Officer 3rd Class Andrew Wood, an aviation maintenance technician at Air Station Corpus Christi, conducted by Lt. Steven Vanderlaske, an MH-65 Dolphin helicopter pilot at Air Station Corpus Christi.

U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Corpus Christi.
